addressBookDeleteDescription: Delete the address "{{label}}"? This cannot be undone.
addressBookDescription: Save a Solana address for a FiMs member or an exchange account.
communityDisclaimer: Indicative figures provided for information only, computed from community-reported data. They are neither a guarantee of value nor a repayment commitment.
converterHint: Indicative estimate based on the latest known prices — no transaction is created.
debtCarveBody: You still owe {{amount}} to the tontine ({{rate}}%-of-gains rule) — your share is collected automatically on every send or swap.
debtCheckPending: Sends temporarily blocked: checking your FiMs balance rules — retry in a moment.
demoSendBlocked: The guided-tour demo wallet has public keys and cannot send funds.
disclaimer: FiMs Wallet is a portfolio tracking tool, not investment advice. Past performance is no guarantee of future results. Everyone is solely responsible for their own decisions and any losses.
donationsRemainingHint: {{rate}}% of gains go to FiMs work: paid to the Tontine or given to a charity of your choice (proof required).
gasTopupBody: Solana charges network fees and account rent in SOL — SOL is the gas of this wallet, not an investment. Your SOL balance is too low to send transactions. Convert some of your tokens to refill the {{reserve}} SOL reserve.
gasTopupCost: This will convert ≈ {{amount}} {{symbol}} into {{sol}} SOL of gas.
gasTopupNoTokens: No swappable token available — deposit tokens first.
gasTopupQuoteError: No route found for this token. Try another one.
gasTopupSuccess: Gas refilled — you can retry your transaction.
learnAddressesBody: Before each send, check the full recipient address on the confirmation screen. A transaction cannot be undone.
learnBitpandaBody: European broker to buy crypto in EUR. Pros: EU-regulated, simple for beginners. Cons: higher fees than an exchange, custodial.
learnCoinbaseBody: Buy crypto by card or bank transfer. Pros: simple, regulated, card available in some countries. Cons: relatively high fees and spread; custodial account.
learnCryptoDesc: The basic notions to read the tokens, swaps and prices displayed.
learnCurrentValueBody: Estimated value of your share of the FiMs portfolio today, computed from the latest known price of each token.
learnDcaBody: Investing a fixed amount on a regular schedule (e.g. €50/month) instead of a lump sum. It smooths the entry price and reduces the risk of buying at a peak — it does not remove the risk of loss.
learnDiversifyBody: Spreading funds across several assets so a single drop hurts less. Beginners should favor a majority of low-volatility assets.
learnDonationsBody: FiMs plans to give back {{rate}}% of gains: to the Tontine or to a charity (with a receipt). “Remaining to donate” shows what is missing to reach that rule.
learnDyorBody: “Do Your Own Research”: read about a token before investing. Past returns guarantee nothing.
learnFeesBody: Every operation costs a Solana network fee (in SOL) and sometimes a platform commission — shown before confirmation. FiMs also deducts a {{fee}}% operating fee on swaps, conversions and withdrawals, which stays in the treasury, and members owe a tontine contribution on their gains (min. 10%). Multisig operations show their estimated cost (network fee, account rent, Squads creation fee) before you sign.
learnFiguresDesc: What the values shown in the Account and Community tabs mean.
learnInvestedBody: Total payments you made to FiMs (via Nexo, Coinbase or in crypto). It is your starting stake, not the current value.
learnJupiterBody: Not a card: it is the swap aggregator used inside FiMs Wallet to convert tokens at the best rate. Pros: best-price routing on Solana. Cons: crypto only — no EUR deposits. Referral code: 2MJD7MJF.
learnLimitBody: An exchange that only executes if the price reaches your target. Useful to sell on a rise or buy on a dip.
learnMethodsDesc: Ways to invest more calmly, especially for beginners.
learnMultisigBody: A wallet requiring several signatures (e.g. 2 of 3) to move funds — useful for a treasury. FiMs Wallet does not manage multisig yet; Squads is the reference on Solana.
learnNexoBody: Crypto card and earn products. Pros: card usable in shops, EUR support. Cons: custodial — your assets are held by Nexo (counterparty risk).
learnNotAdviceBody: FiMs is a tracking tool, not an adviser. Nothing shown here is a recommendation to buy or sell.
learnPnlBody: Difference between the current value and the total invested. Green = gain, red = loss. It is only an estimate until anything is sold.
learnRatiosBody: “Day” = value change since the previous day. “Total” = return since your first payment.
learnRisksDesc: The golden rules to not lose your funds.
learnScamBody: No legitimate person will ever ask for your recovery phrase or funds “to unlock” a transaction.
learnSeedBody: It alone can restore your wallet. Never share it with anyone — not even the FiMs team.
learnServicesDesc: External services around the wallet — for information only. Some links are FiMs affiliate links (they may give you or FiMs a bonus).
learnSolanaBody: The blockchain FiMs runs on. SOL is its native currency: it pays network fees (a few cents per operation).
learnStablecoinsBody: Tokens pegged to a currency. Less volatile, but not risk-free: the issuer or the peg can fail. “Lower risk”, never “no risk”.
learnSwapBody: Converting one token into another. FiMs uses Jupiter, which compares prices across Solana markets to get the best rate.
learnTokensBody: Digital assets traded on Solana (USDC, EURC, JUP…). Their price moves constantly with supply and demand.
learnTontineBody: A shared pot funded by the members. It acts as a solidarity reserve and pays FiMs operating costs.
learnTreasuryBody: The public wallet holding the FiMs funds. You can check its contents anytime via the audit link at the bottom of the page.
learnVolatilityBody: Crypto prices can rise or fall very fast (±10% in a day is not unusual). Never invest more than you can afford to lose.
learnYieldCurrentBody: The “Current rate” is a projection: what the position would earn over a year if the current conditions held. The “Real rate” is what was actually earned — gains vs amount invested, expressed as an annual percentage from the real history. Only the real rate is measured; the current rate is an estimate.
learnYieldRiskBody: Staking or lending returns come with counterparty or slashing risk: the higher the advertised yield, the higher the risk usually is.
limitFeeNote: A {{fee}}% FiMs operating fee is charged on the received token when the order settles.
memberClaimLinked: Wallet linked to the existing member.
memberClaimNameHint: If this name already exists and one of your wallets is linked to it, this wallet will be attached to that member instead of creating a duplicate.
memberClaimNameTaken: This name is already taken. Import a wallet already linked to that member to prove ownership.
memberClaimRegistered: You are now registered as a FiMs member.
memberNotFoundDescription: No FiMs member is linked to this wallet address.
multisigCostEstimateOnly: Network fee only — the transaction would currently fail, so the full cost could not be simulated.
multisigDesc: Shared wallets secured by Squads v4: several members must approve each spend. Proposals, votes and spending limits are enforced on-chain — they cannot be bypassed.
multisigEmpty: No multisig yet — create one below or add an existing one by address.
multisigInvalidThreshold: Threshold must be between 1 and the member count
multisigMembersHint: Base58 addresses, space or comma separated
multisigNoLimits: No spending limit — any approved spend can leave the vault.
multisigNoTreasury: Squads program config unavailable on this network
multisigNotFound: Multisig account not found on this network.
multisigUseNote: Spending under a limit skips the proposal vote — the cap is enforced on-chain by the program.
multisigVoteCost: Approving, rejecting, cancelling or executing a proposal each costs a small network fee (≈ 0.000005 SOL). Creating a proposal also rents new on-chain accounts — the estimate is shown in each form.
newTransactions_other: {{count}} new transactions on your FiMs account
noSolDescription: This wallet has no SOL. You need a small amount of SOL to pay network fees when sending tokens.
profileCooldownHint: The profile can only be edited once a day.
ratioDayTooltip: Portfolio value change since the previous day
ratioTotalTooltip: Total return since your first investment
rebalanceDrift: Drift: {{drift}} points away from your target.
rebalanceFee: Includes the 0.1% operating fee ({{amount}}), retained by the treasury.
rebalanceNoTarget: Set a risky/safe target to monitor your portfolio drift.
rebalanceTargetHint: Desired split between risky and stable assets.
sendCapBlocked: Send blocked: {{total}} exceeds your send limit of {{cap}}. Raise or clear it in Settings → General.
sendConvertNotice: {{label}} only accepts {{accepted}}. Your tokens will be converted automatically in the same transaction.
sendConvertQuoteFailed: Could not get a conversion quote — the token may be illiquid.
sendDestAcceptedNote: This service accepts: {accepted}. Any other token is converted automatically.
sendDestCheckFailed: Could not verify the address — try again.
sendDestGuideCoinbase:
1. Open Coinbase → Assets → the token to receive (USDC, EURC, SOL or cbBTC) → Receive.
2. Select the Solana network.
3. Copy your deposit address and paste it below.
sendDestGuideJupiter:
1. Open Jupiter → Spend (app.jup.ag/spend).
2. Get your USDC/USDT deposit address.
3. Paste it below.
sendDestGuideNexo:
1. Open Nexo → Top up → USDC or SOL → Solana network.
2. Copy your deposit address and paste it below.
sendDestNotWallet: This is a token or program address, not a wallet — funds would be lost.
sendDestReferral: No account yet? Sign up on {provider}
solExcessBody: You hold {{excess}} SOL above the {{reserve}} SOL gas reserve. SOL is only used for transaction fees in this wallet — convert the excess to FSOL to keep SOL exposure as a swappable token.
solExcessQuoteError: Unable to fetch a conversion quote.
swapDisclaimer: On-chain swap via Jupiter: irreversible once signed. Always check the received amount and price impact. FiMs operating fee: {{fee}}% deducted from the swapped amount.
swapFeesIncluded: DEX and protocol fees are already included in the quoted amount.
swapImpactBlocked: Swap blocked: price impact {{impact}}% exceeds the {{max}}% safety limit.
swapNoSwappableInput: No swappable tokens yet — SOL is gas-only and other tokens are not supported.
swapPriceImpactBlocked: Price impact too high — conversion blocked for your safety.
swapRiskWarning: {{symbol}} is a volatile asset — its price can drop sharply. Only invest what you can afford to lose; consider gradual purchases (DCA).
swapRiskWarningHigh: {{symbol}} is highly volatile — sharp swings are common. Only invest what you can afford to lose; prefer gradual purchases (DCA).
swapUnsafeMint: Blocked: the "{{symbol}}" token points to an unexpected mint — the token list may have been tampered with.
swapViaStrategy: Issued by the FiMs vault: {{symbol}} arrives within ~1 minute — you never hold the collateral.
swapWatchOnly: A watch-only account cannot sign swaps.
tokenChartHint: Each token is rebased to 100 at its first recorded price — slopes are comparable. Badges: 1-day / total variation.
tontineDonateFreeNote: Free donation, whenever you want — no FiMs fee on donations, your gift arrives in full.
votesMyPower: Your voting power: {{power}} — {{share}} % of the total
votesProposeCreated: Proposal submitted — an admin must open it for voting
votesProposeHint: Your proposal lands as a draft: an admin validates it before the vote opens.
votesProposeTitle: Propose an idea for the tontine
votesWeightInvestment: Weight proportional to your total investment.
votesWeightTontine: Weight proportional to your Tontine contributions.
